dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Alright, this should do the trick.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Here, check this out: A new formula I just whipped up. Works like a charm for juvenile saurians suffering from appetite loss.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Just one problem. It's too good. If juveniles without appetite issues eat it, they... Let's just say they start binging.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Case in point, a few days ago Cacucu swiped two tablets while I wasn't looking, and...

dialogues.speaker: Cacucu
dialogues.text: Still got room for seconds, bro!

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Haha! Looks like the flavor profile needs a tweak.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Otherwise, Natlan's gonna have a juvenile saurian obesity epidemic shortly.
